blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The government’s Unified 911 emergency hotline recorded 96,447 calls in the first 10 months of 2026, with a reported efficiency rate of 96.64%, the Department of the Local and Interior Government (DILG) said Tuesday. The logged calls from Jan. 1 to Oct. 30 involve police assistance, fire emergencies, medical concerns, search and rescue operations and cases of violence against women and children, the DILG said. READ: Cambodia, Vietnam look to PH for 911 blueprint The Unified 911 was launched in September 2025 as the country’s single emergency hotline for police, fire, medical and rescue assistance.
